foundry_calls.text: Borin Ironpot, at your service. Mind the seven-fingered handshake — the left one's mostly decorative.
foundry_calls.speaker: Borin

foundry_calls.text: He polishes a tankard with a cloth that's seen better decades, watching your sword belt with an innkeeper's practised eye.
foundry_calls.speaker: Sage

llm_calls: [Aria]: I walk up to the bar and ask the innkeeper his name.
